meta.name: motion-graphics
meta.description: A short, design-led motion graphic where motion is the message — kinetic typography, stat count-up, chart/data-viz hit, logo sting / brand lockup, lower-third / callout / social overlay, animated map (highlight regions, connect places, zoom to a location), animated tweet / news-article / headline, webpage / UI animation (scroll, cursor, callouts), or fusing a real image's geometry into a chart. Usually under 10s (up to ~30s), no narration or live-action subject; renders to MP4 or transparent overlay. Longer / narrated / multi-scene → /general-video. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把标题、数据或地图变成动态短片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想做会动的标题、图表或地图,又不想学专业软件
copy.tagline_en: Turn headlines, data, or maps into short animated videos
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to bring titles, charts, or maps to life without learning pro software.

howto.what: 装上后，当你要求制作短动态图形时，Claude 会规划并生成一个通常 10 秒以内、无旁白的动画视频，输出为 MP4 或透明叠加层，可涵盖动态文字、数据图表、标志揭示等类型。
howto.when: 当你请求制作无旁白的短动态图形（通常10秒内），例如动态排版、数字增长、图表动画等时触发。若内容更长、带旁白或多场景，则转用 /general-video。

say.text: 把这句话做成动态文字动画。
say.note: 会生成一段短动效视频。

say.text: 做一个数字从0数到100的动画。
给这个logo设计一个揭示动画。

howto.what_en: A skill for creating short motion graphics. On request, Claude builds a design-led animated video, usually under 10s, no narration, rendered as MP4 or transparent overlay. Covers kinetic typography, data charts, logo stings, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a short, unnarrated motion graphic (usually under 10s), e.g. kinetic typography, stat count-ups, chart animations. Longer, narrated, or multi-scene work goes to /general-video.

say_en.text: Make this sentence into kinetic typography.
Animate a number counting from 0 to 100.
Design a logo reveal animation for this brand.
